title: Output Schema for PGP Encrypt Operation
description: Output schema for the cryptography pgpEncrypt operation.

payload.description: The ciphertext: ASCII-armored text (armor=true) or base64 of the binary ciphertext (armor=false). Present in the response variable when overwriteBody is false; when overwriteBody is true the ciphertext is written to the message body instead (raw application/octet-stream when armor=false).

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
